name: dc-el_alamein_day2-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat El Alamein Day 2 co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: a DC-made level with DC's own AI data and four helicopter types both sides fly (Mi-24, Mi-8, AH-64, UH-60). Its co-op ObjectSpawnTemplates name the AC-130, A-10B, F-16, MiG-29 and Su-25, but its ObjectSpawns place none of them (dc-gazala-coop-rec has the AC-130). Also T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, BRDM-2/Humvee, M163/Shilka, M-109/M-1974, BM-21/MLRS and the Scud. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let it play two rounds (each ends on tickets or at the 25-minute limit), then `lab.py stop`.
